criteria.requirement: Add separate wrapt.ttl_cache.ttl_cache(ttl,maxsize=128,clock=monotonic). Use finite explicit nonnegative TTL from successful computation COMPLETION, maxsize bounded LRU and global expired-entry purge on call/info; zero TTL/maxsize disables storing. Injectable clock for exact deterministic tests, reject nonfinite/backward clock or invalid budget. Exceptions never cached, results maintain identity, cache_info/cache_clear defined. Thread RLock serializes computation/clear; no cross-key concurrency promise. Hashable args/sorted kwargs keys include method self with normal cache retention; preserve existing lru_cache unchanged.
